title: PQNK Farmer Advisory Knowledge Record
$comment: REVISION 1.4.2 (pre-deployment hardening): added originReferenceNumber (self-contained provenance, sec below) and clarified that approvedBy is the record's answer-author provenance field, enforced by provenance.ts at the single insert site -- ASK PQNK GENERATED ANSWER != PEDAVER KNOWLEDGE (ASK_PQNK_ARCHITECTURE.md sec 19). No field was removed or renamed. Carried forward from REVISION 1.3: 'language' (below) now explicitly documented as the ORIGINAL QUESTION's language only -- 'answer'/'shortAnswer'/'practicalAction' are always composed in English regardless, per the locked simplification removing multilingual answer generation (ASK_PQNK_ARCHITECTURE.md sec 8, sec 18). No field was added, removed, or renamed. Carried forward from REVISION 1.2 (locked decisions): (1) Published records are PERMANENT knowledge -- there is no auto-deletion of an approved Q&A record; see PEDAVER_REFERRAL_WORKFLOW.md sec 13 for what IS time-limited (personal contact info and unpublished submission evidence, which are never part of THIS schema in the first place -- see personalDataSeparation note below). (2) Pedaver is the sole approval authority -- 'approvedBy' names the Pedaver reviewer who issued the answer; there is no second-reviewer/dual-sign-off field. (3) supersedesOrClarifies is new: the mechanism by which a Farmer Advisory record can outrank an older Paper or Media item on a specific claim, per SOURCE_AUTHORITY_POLICY.md sec 4 -- explicit and reviewer-asserted, never inferred from date alone. (4) Added machinery, geography, relatedFarmerAdvisories, problemFamily per the locked minimum field list.
description: Draft schema for Ask PQNK 1.2 -- architecture only, not yet implemented. This is Farmer Advisory's structured content model: the same record is produced internally when Pedaver answers a referred question, and IS the public Farmer Advisory record once published. Searchable by Ask PQNK as a first-class Tier 2 source (SOURCE_AUTHORITY_POLICY.md).

question.description: The original farmer question, in the language/wording it was asked. This IS part of the permanent public knowledge record -- retaining and publishing the agricultural question itself does not require the asker's permission (locked decision). See personalDataSeparation below for what is deliberately excluded.

canonicalQuestion.description: Normalized, single reference phrasing of the underlying question, typically English for internal search/reporting consistency regardless of the record's answer language.

farmerLanguageWording.description: Colloquial terms/phrasing actually used (any script/transliteration) -- retrieval-matching value, preserved as agricultural context, not personal information.

fieldContext.description: Context needed to understand the question -- e.g. soil type, irrigation source, recent weather, symptom description as the farmer gave it. Agricultural context, retained; distinct from personal/location-identifying detail (see personalDataSeparation).

questionCluster.description: ID of the associated question cluster (definitions.questionCluster / PEDAVER_REFERRAL_WORKFLOW.md sec 5), if any.

questionVariants.description: Other phrasings of the same underlying question. Superseded in detail by questionCluster.variantQuestions where a cluster exists; kept for records with no formal cluster.

answer.description: Full answer / mechanism, in Pedaver's own words as issued.

practicalAction.description: The concrete 'what to do' step(s), kept as its own field so Ask PQNK's What-to-do section can render it directly.

language.description: Language the ORIGINAL QUESTION was asked in -- retained for context/analytics and for the referral message (ASK_PQNK_ARCHITECTURE.md sec 18). Per Revision 1.3, 'answer' above is always composed in English regardless of this value; this field never implies the answer text is in this language.

problemFamily.description: REVISION 1.2 addition. Coarser problemFamilies grouping (taxonomy.json), useful for the queue's 'most common unresolved problems' view even before every fieldProblem is precisely tagged.

machinery.description: REVISION 1.2 addition. Canonical machinery names from taxonomy.json machineryTools, where applicable.

geography.description: REVISION 1.2 addition. Region/district-level agricultural context where materially relevant to the answer (e.g. a salinity or climate answer that's regionally specific), NOT a precise farm location -- see personalDataSeparation.

publicationStatus.description: 'Published' is permanent. There is no scheduled expiry or auto-deletion of a Published record -- see notes.permanentRetention below.

advisoryReference.description: Once Published, the slug/identifier this record is exposed under in the public Farmer Advisory section.

supersedesOrClarifies.description: REVISION 1.2 addition -- the mechanism behind SOURCE_AUTHORITY_POLICY.md sec 4's ranking rule. An explicit, reviewer-asserted claim that this record updates or clarifies a specific prior source for a specific point. Never inferred automatically; set only when a Pedaver reviewer actually intends this record to be treated as the current position over the named one.

note.description: Short reviewer note on what changed/clarified -- shown internally, and optionally surfaced to the farmer as 'this updates earlier guidance on X.'

approvedBy.description: The Pedaver reviewer who issued this answer. Pedaver is the sole approval authority for publication -- there is no second-reviewer field (locked decision). REVISION 1.4.2: this IS the record's answer-author provenance field -- always the literal string 'Pedaver', enforced independently at the single insert site by provenance.ts's assertPedaverAuthoredPublication (ASK_PQNK_ARCHITECTURE.md sec 19). Never AI, never any other value; there is no code path that can set this to anything else.

relatedMedia.description: Media record/segment IDs from authenticated Pedaver YouTube/Facebook sources -- the 'Watch' citations.

relatedFarmerAdvisories.description: REVISION 1.2 addition. IDs of other Farmer Advisory records covering closely related questions -- lets Ask PQNK say 'related advisories' the way Related Knowledge already does for Papers/Science.

originQuestionModality.description: How the originating question arrived, if known. Analytics only -- the published record is always structured text regardless.

supersededBy.description: ID of the record that replaces this one, if Pedaver later issues an improved/expanded answer. Historical versions are retained permanently for internal traceability -- see notes.versioning.

originReferenceNumber.description: REVISION 1.4.2 addition. The human-facing PQNK-Q-XXXXXXXX reference number of the referral_queue entry this record originated from, stored directly here so provenance survives independently of originQueueId's join target (ASK_PQNK_ARCHITECTURE.md sec 19 point 3). Every published record has one -- there is no publication path that doesn't trace back through Refer this Question to Pedaver.

questionCluster.description: Unchanged in shape from 1.1. Repeated questions are a knowledge-gap signal, not N separate records.

notes.permanentRetention: LOCKED 1.2: a Published record is permanent knowledge. It is never subject to a scheduled deletion. This is deliberately different from the submission-time evidence (photos/video/voice, contact info) described in PEDAVER_REFERRAL_WORKFLOW.md sec 13, which lives in a separate structure entirely -- see personalDataSeparation.
notes.personalDataSeparation: LOCKED 1.2: this schema never carries the farmer's name, WhatsApp number, email, or precise location. Those fields exist only in the internal Pedaver Answers Queue entry (PEDAVER_REFERRAL_WORKFLOW.md sec 8), used solely to deliver the answer back to that specific person, and are handled under that document's retention rules -- not this one. A Published record contains the agricultural question, context needed to understand it, Pedaver's answer, classifications, sources, and related knowledge -- never contact information.
notes.versioning: A record is never silently edited in place once Published. A revision creates version N+1, sets supersededBy on version N, and version N remains permanently queryable as historical context -- 'preserve version history... while retaining historical traceability internally' (locked decision). Retrieval always prefers the current (non-superseded) version.
notes.advisoryModelReconciliation: LOCKED 1.2: proceed with evolving the live, currently-empty AdvisoryNote model (src/lib/content/advisory.ts) into this schema, rather than stretching the lighter model long-term. Implementation detail (migration path for the 5 existing AdvisoryCategorySlug values) is addressed in ASK_PQNK_V1_IMPLEMENTATION_SPEC.md.
